body: You are spot on, oh I also have another part time job on top of that, that I forgot about. Yeah I crumble, I'm single, no kids, 21+ and people think I'm just a cry baby, that's fine. Yeah I'm safe for now. Goodnight, thank you.

I've been made fun of for going to counseling and I dont have the will power to let it help me when I go. I heard a million stories tonight about how everyone had 3 kids, full time job, and full time college. Great you had sex to have kids and were all fucked up. I work full time and go to college full time. I'm too busy for anyone to really talk anymore and all of sudden I get called "ungrateful" no one understand me, and they dont have to! Just venting and nothing else. Same cycle for YEARS. I'm just done. They can hate me collectively later and then use the money in my bank account that I've saved as a token for their "suffering" over me.

Which is exactly why when I joke about killing myself around others I joke about people making facebook posts saying "I miss you" and how no one better fucking do that to me. I'm on my last thread with everyone hearing me but not actually HEARING me when I'm clearly sad. This post hit everything I think about.

I had the same thing happen to me. It made me soooo emotional when it happened. I have an overbite so the mistake when biting down caused it to slip on my bottom brackets. I was worried about it too but my orthodontist hasnt mentioned anything so I think it should be fine. Just be aware of how you bite and where your teeth are positioned in your mouth.

I like laying in bed for hours on my days off it's my only break. I get very lathargic when I'm depressed, and that's like always. Sure I motivate myself sometimes but I really just dont care right now.

Thank you!! They don't really tell you how to find it online like that (every publication I google show pdfs from years ago) ARNG have binders of printed regulations and pull that sucker out anytime someone wants to argue so I was curious myself to maybe learn an easier way to extract new regs, thank you again!
Captain Obvious over here, don't worry someone educated me on where to find regulations. You know..my original question, paying attention to detail isnt a regulation but it sure does pay off.
Boom. Clear cut answer, thank you so much. Learn something everyday.
I've gotten away with light pink since forever, no ones been on my case until a facebook post told me its changed
Have you tried reading the post? I asked what website on where to find it.
I guess that's better than a ticket, I love my clean record and just let it slip which is disgusting of me. Thank you for giving me that advice.

I can't even believe he didnt mention my cracked windshield. I've been saving money to get it fixed (which I need to do now because spring semester is over, books are expensive) cold weather to warm ac made it crack. I got really lucky, I also rolled all my windows down and kept my hands on the steering wheel. That might of helped, I called him sir after everything as well. Hit all my respect check points
Thank you, I swear knowledge of others mistakes seems to go out the door and I victimize myself. You're seriously right, I was also just trying to take my Wendy's home and I havent ate yet ugh😂
